C9000305.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 305 (Four-dimensional disk embedding and Wall's conjecture.; papers: A boundary-only obstruction to four-dimensional disk embedding; A marked tensor obstruction to four-dimensional disk embedding; A PD4 group without an aspherical manifold model; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_PD4_MAIN.statement: The specified group G admits the finite oriented aspherical PD4 complex Q, but no closed aspherical topological four-manifold model.

C_PD4_REALIZATION_SETUP.statement: The reflection and stabilization constructions supply the claimed PD4 complex and the marked periodic sphere systems from a hypothetical manifold model.

C_PD4_CHAMBER_OBSTRUCTION.statement: The specified marked boundary S to BH admits no compact topological graph-type filling extending that marking.

C_PD4_REMOVAL.statement: Proposition ct:removal produces a compact graph-type filling V of S by interior surgery on Z, with the original central marking.

C_PD4_PREPARATION.statement: The labelled outer sphere systems admit the uniform finite preparation of ct:preparation, including full protected capped-surface duality.

C_PD4_DIRECTIONS.statement: Lemma ct:directions constructs the far-out small direction images and the required central-marking comparison after peeling.

C_PD4_POSTCAP_TOWERS.statement: The construction of Z, complement-group comparison, post-null-loop towers with geometric duals, Lagrangian surgeries and regular-coefficient homology calculation supply the remaining hypotheses of ct:removal.

C_UPPER_REPLACEMENT.statement: Lemma ct:upper-replacement with all original relative hypotheses and an upper-component smallness threshold independent of component count.

C_UPPER_PATCH_BOUND.statement: For arbitrary component families, unchanged body anchors within delta of K and component diameters below 49*3^(q-1)*delta put the whole union within 3^(q+3)*delta of K, for every q>=1.

C_UPPER_RELATIVE_FQ.statement: The FQ two-phase construction can be performed in the relative complement of the retained stages and entire protected capped surfaces, preserving original bodies and framed attaching regions until the final individual contractions.
